SGLANG_DISTRIBUTED_INIT_METHOD_OVERRIDE.description: Override the distributed init method used by torch.distributed.init_process_group. Set to "env://" to use an externally-created TCPStore via MASTER_ADDR/MASTER_PORT.

SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_THREAD_POOL_SIZE.description: NOTE: For SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_THREAD_POOL_SIZE, the effective default is computed dynamically at runtime based on cpu_count; see disaggregation backends.

SGLANG_ENCODER_MM_RECEIVER_MODE.description: Encoder receiver selection: http|grpc (used by EPD paths).

SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_NUM_PRE_ALLOCATE_R.description: Extra slots in req_to_token_pool for decode workers (only effective when max_num_reqs > 32). Increases pool capacity so more KV cache transfers can overlap with decode execution without raising max_running_requests.

SGLANG_EMPTY_CACHE_INTERVAL.description: in seconds. Set if you observe high memory accumulation over a long serving period.

SGLANG_FORCE_STREAM_INTERVAL.description: For non-streaming requests, the scheduler still flushes intermediate output batches to the tokenizer manager every N decoded tokens so that `first_token_time`/TTFT can be recorded. Lower this (e.g. to 1) to get an accurate TTFT for benchmarking; the upstream default of 50 trades off some TTFT-metric accuracy for less IPC overhead.

SGLANG_DISAGG_STAGING_BUFFER.description: Staging buffer for heterogeneous TP KV transfer

SGLANG_STAGING_USE_TORCH.description: TODO(yangminl): remove SGLANG_STAGING_USE_TORCH and the torch fallback in staging_buffer.py once Triton kernels are fully validated in production.

SGLANG_NPU_FORWARD_NATIVE_GELUTANH.description: Forward native implementation for activation gelu tanh for model Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B-v0.2

SGLANG_NPU_FORWARD_NATIVE_GEMMA_RMS_NORM.description: Forward native implementation for gemma rms norm for model Skywork-Reward-Gemma-2-27B-v0.2

SGLANG_USE_AG_AFTER_QLORA.description: Delay all-gather after qlora for better performance for Deepseek v3.2

DEEP_NORMAL_MODE_USE_INT8_QUANT.description: Quantize x to int8 in the dispatch operator

SGLANG_FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_SIZE.description: Default to the pick from flashinfer

SGLANG_SKIP_SOFTMAX_PREFILL_THRESHOLD_SC.description: Skip-softmax threshold scale factor for TRT-LLM attention (prefill and decode separately). None = standard attention. See https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.12087

SGLANG_FLASHINFER_FORCE_POSIX_FD_TRANSPO.description: TODO(mmangkad): Remove this once the FlashInfer unified allreduce-fusion transport issue on GB200/GB300 platforms is fixed and verified resolved.

SGLANG_USE_1STAGE_ALLREDUCE.description: Use 1-stage all-reduce kernel on AMD (deterministic, fixed accumulation order) If not set: auto (enabled when --enable-deterministic-inference is on) Set to 1: force enable (even without --enable-deterministic-inference) Set to 0: force disable (use default Aiter AR even with --enable-deterministic-inference)

SGLANG_WARMUP_TIMEOUT.description: in seconds. If a warmup forward batch takes longer than this, the server will crash to prevent hanging. Recommend to increase warmup timeout to 1800 to accommodate some kernel JIT precache e.g. deep gemm
